def get_indexer_non_unique(self, target):
    """
    Return the indices of the passed values in the Index.

    Parameters
    ----------
    target : array_like
        The values to return the index for.

    Returns
    -------
    indexer : ndarray
        The locations of the values in the target array.
    missing : ndarray
        An array of the same shape as `target` containing the locations
        of the missing values in the target array.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError
        When an element of `target` is not found in the Index.
    """
    target = ensure_index(target)
    pself, ptarget = self._maybe_promote(target)
    if pself is not self or ptarget is not target:
        return pself.get_indexer_non_unique(ptarget)
    if is_categorical(target):
        tgt_values = np.asarray(target)
    elif self.is_all_dates:  # <--- BUGGY LINE
        tgt_values = target.asi8
    else:
        tgt_values = target._ndarray_values
    indexer, missing = self._engine.get_indexer_non_unique(tgt_values)
    return (ensure_platform_int(indexer), missing)

def __init__(self, df, na_rep: str='', float_format: Optional[str]=None, cols: Optional[Sequence[Label]]=None, header: Union[Sequence[Label], bool]=True, index: bool=True, index_label: Optional[Union[Label, Sequence[Label]]]=None, merge_cells: bool=False, inf_rep: str='inf', style_converter: Optional[Callable]=None):
    self.rowcounter = 0
    self.na_rep = na_rep
    if hasattr(df, 'render'):
        self.styler = df
        df = df.data
        if style_converter is None:
            style_converter = CSSToExcelConverter()
        self.style_converter = style_converter
    else:
        self.styler = None
    self.df = df
    if cols is not None:
        if not len(Index(cols) & df.columns):
            raise KeyError('passes columns are not ALL present dataframe')
        if len(Index(cols) & df.columns) != len(cols):
            raise KeyError("Not all names specified in 'columns' are found")
        self.df = df.reindex(columns=cols)
    self.columns = self.df.columns
    self.float_format = float_format
    self.index = index
    self.index_label = index_label
    self.header = header
    self.merge_cells = merge_cells
    self.inf_rep = inf_rep
